title: Feature Request: Sensor end-of-life warning
body:
I am using a Dexcom G6 with xdrip on my phone and watch. 
One little feature that I would love to have is a sensor end-of-life reminder before the G6 sensor actually stops running. 
I know that I can see the sensors start time and the days since I started the sensor. It would just be comfortable to get a short reminder 24h before the sensor actually stops. 
Do you think this is an interesting feature for XDrip? 
If so, I could try adding it via a pull request myself.
